memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Moses, "Take a census also of the Gershonites by their families and clans. Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting. This is the service of the Gershonite clans in their carrying and their other work: they are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, its covering and the durable covering of leather over it, and the curtains for the entrance to the tent of meeting." - Num 4:21-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Now it is the Gershonites' turn to be counted and given their work — carrying the curtains, coverings, and hangings of the tabernacle. Like the Kohathites, they too were counted between thirty and fifty, in the season of their strength.

The Gershonites handled the fabric of God's dwelling — the coverings that formed and enclosed the sacred space. It was different work from the Kohathites, who carried the holy furnishings, but it was no less part of God's plan. Every clan had its own share in the one great task of caring for the house of God.

This is such an important truth for God's people. We are not all called to the same work. Some handle the "furnishings," some the "curtains," some the "framework." What matters is not that everyone does the same thing, but that everyone does their part faithfully.

Comparison is the thief of contentment. The Gershonites did not need to envy the Kohathites, nor the Kohathites the priests. Each had been given a good and needed role by God Himself.

The New Testament teaches the same about the church: many members, many gifts, one body (Rom 12:4-6). Whatever your assigned work, embrace it. God has given it to you on purpose, and He is pleased when you do it well.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you compare your role with others' and feel discontent?
- How can you embrace the work God has specifically given you?
- Who around you serves in a different but equally needed way?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me to embrace the work You have given me without comparing it to others. Teach me to serve faithfully in my own place. Amen.
